prompt: Patrol the apartment and take photos of the windows

task.prompt: Patrol the apartment and take photos of the windows

design.summary: A compact 4WD Raspberry Pi robot equipped with a camera module to patrol the apartment and take photos of all windows.

reasons.pi4b-4gb: Serves as the main controller for processing and controlling the robot.
reasons.chassis-4wd-m: Provides a four-wheel drive chassis that balances and carries the camera.
reasons.md-tb6612: Provides dual DC motor channels to drive the chassis wheels.
reasons.bat-nimh-900: Provides a 7.2V rechargeable power source for the robot and step-down regulator.
reasons.reg-5v-3a: Regulates 7.2V battery voltage down to 5V at up to 3.2A to reliably power the Raspberry Pi.
reasons.cam-pi3: Captures high-resolution photographs of the windows during patrol.
